spec: Part IX seed data · Appendix B (~80 exercises: pattern, equipment, level, type, cueLine, swapGroup, holdSeconds?) · Flow 1 step 3 (PPL, mobility block) · Flow 3 (setup cues, mobility holds) · T004
swapRule: GAP (Flow 1 step 4 promises 3–5 alternatives that do the same job; 5.6.1/8.3 say same pattern + equipment): SwapFinder takes candidates with the user's equipment access and the same type, never the incumbent, in tiers — same swapGroup first, then same pattern, then same region — widening only while fewer than swapCandidatesMin are found, ranked same-or-lower level first, capped at swapCandidatesMax.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.cueLine: Eyes under the bar, feet planted, lower to mid-chest and press up and slightly back.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.cueLine: Dumbbells over your chest, elbows about 45° from your sides, press up until they nearly touch.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.cueLine: Bench at 30°, press from the upper chest, don't let the dumbbells drift over your face.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.cueLine: Seat so the handles sit at mid-chest, press forward and stop just short of locking out.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.cueLine: Hands under the shoulders, body one straight line, chest to the floor and back up.

exercises.name: Incline Push-Up
exercises.cueLine: Hands on a bench or counter — the higher the surface, the easier the push.

exercises.name: Decline Push-Up
exercises.cueLine: Feet on a bench, hands under the shoulders, chest to the floor with a tight core.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
exercises.cueLine: Lie on the floor, upper arms touch the ground at the bottom, press straight up.

exercises.name: Dip
exercises.cueLine: Lean slightly forward, lower until the upper arms are parallel to the floor, press back up.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
exercises.cueLine: Handles at chest height, soft elbows, sweep your hands together in front of you.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Chest Fly
exercises.cueLine: Slight bend in the elbows, open wide until you feel the stretch, squeeze back up.

exercises.name: Pec Deck
exercises.cueLine: Pads at chest height, elbows slightly bent, bring the pads together slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press
exercises.cueLine: Bar at the collarbone, squeeze the glutes, press straight up and push your head through.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.cueLine: Dumbbells at ear height, press up until the arms lock out, lower under control.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.cueLine: Handles level with your ears, press up, don't shrug.

exercises.name: Pike Push-Up
exercises.cueLine: Hips high in a pike, lower the top of your head toward the floor, press back up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.cueLine: Slight lean forward, raise to shoulder height leading with the elbows.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.cueLine: Cable set low, raise the arm out to the side until level with the shoulder.

exercises.name: Machine Lateral Raise
exercises.cueLine: Pads just above the elbows, raise until the upper arms are level with the floor.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
exercises.cueLine: Dumbbells at the thighs, raise them straight in front to shoulder height, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Upright Row
exercises.cueLine: Dumbbells close to the body, pull the elbows up and out to chest height.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Floor Fly
exercises.cueLine: Lie on the floor, soft elbows, open the arms until they touch the ground, squeeze back up.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
exercises.cueLine: Elbows pinned to your sides, push the bar down until the arms are straight.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
exercises.cueLine: Both hands under one dumbbell overhead, lower it behind your head, extend.

exercises.name: Skull Crusher
exercises.cueLine: Lying down, lower the bar toward your forehead with the elbows still, extend back up.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Push-Up
exercises.cueLine: Hands close under your chest, elbows brushing your ribs on the way down.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.cueLine: Hands on a bench behind you, lower until the elbows hit 90°, press up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
exercises.cueLine: Hinge forward, upper arm level with your torso, straighten the arm behind you.

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.cueLine: Hinge to about 45°, pull the bar to your lower ribs, lower under control.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.cueLine: Hand and knee on a bench, pull the dumbbell to your hip, elbow close.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
exercises.cueLine: Chest on an incline bench, row both dumbbells to your ribs, squeeze the shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.cueLine: Sit tall, pull the handle to your stomach, let the shoulder blades open on the return.

exercises.name: Machine Row
exercises.cueLine: Chest against the pad, pull the handles back, pause, return slowly.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.cueLine: Hang under a bar or sturdy table, body straight, pull your chest to the edge.

exercises.name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Row
exercises.cueLine: Hinge forward with a flat back, row both dumbbells to your hips.

exercises.name: Doorframe Row
exercises.cueLine: Hold both sides of a doorframe, lean back with straight arms, pull your chest to the frame.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.cueLine: Overhand grip, pull until your chin clears the bar, lower all the way down.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.cueLine: Underhand grip, chin over the bar, full hang at the bottom.

exercises.name: Negative Pull-Up
exercises.cueLine: Jump or step to the top of a bar, then lower yourself as slowly as you can.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.cueLine: Grip wider than the shoulders, pull the bar to your upper chest, lean back slightly.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up
exercises.cueLine: Kneel on the pad, pull until your chin clears the handles, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Pullover
exercises.cueLine: Lying across a bench, lower one dumbbell behind your head, pull it back over your chest.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.cueLine: Rope at face height, pull toward your eyes with the elbows high and wide.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Fly
exercises.cueLine: Hinge forward, raise the dumbbells out to the sides with a slight elbow bend.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.cueLine: Face the pad, arms out in front, sweep the handles back until level with your shoulders.

exercises.name: Prone Y-Raise
exercises.cueLine: Lie face down, thumbs up, lift the arms into a Y shape and hold a beat.

exercises.name: Prone T-Raise
exercises.cueLine: Lie face down, arms out to the sides, lift them off the floor and squeeze the shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Concentration Curl
exercises.cueLine: Seated, elbow braced on the inner thigh, curl the dumbbell to the shoulder.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.cueLine: Elbows at your sides, curl the bar to your shoulders without swinging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.cueLine: Palms up, curl both dumbbells with the elbows still, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.cueLine: Palms facing each other, curl toward the shoulders, no swing.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.cueLine: Bar on the low pulley, curl to the shoulders, keep tension at the bottom.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl
exercises.cueLine: Upper arms flat on the pad, curl the handles up, lower all the way.

exercises.name: Underhand Inverted Row
exercises.cueLine: Underhand grip on a bar or table edge, pull your chest up, squeeze the biceps.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.cueLine: Bar on the upper back, brace, sit down between your feet until the thighs pass parallel.

exercises.name: Barbell Front Squat
exercises.cueLine: Bar on the front of the shoulders, elbows high, stay tall as you squat.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.cueLine: Hold one dumbbell at your chest, sit down between your heels, chest up.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.cueLine: Feet shoulder-width on the platform, lower until the knees hit 90°, press without locking out.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.cueLine: Feet shoulder-width, arms forward, sit down until the thighs are parallel.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squat
exercises.cueLine: A dumbbell in each hand at your sides, squat to parallel with a tall chest.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
exercises.cueLine: Squat to parallel, jump, land softly and sink straight into the next rep.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.cueLine: Pad on the shins, extend until the legs are straight, lower under control.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cueLine: Soft knees, push the hips back, the bar slides down the thighs until the hamstrings pull.

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.cueLine: Bar over mid-foot, flat back, push the floor away and stand tall.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cueLine: Dumbbells in front of the thighs, hips back, lower to mid-shin, stand up.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.cueLine: Upper back on a bench, bar over the hips, drive up until the hips are level.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.cueLine: On your back, feet flat, squeeze the glutes and lift the hips until the body is straight.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.cueLine: One foot flat, the other leg straight, drive the hips up with the planted foot.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl
exercises.cueLine: Pad just above the heels, curl toward your glutes, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Nordic Curl
exercises.cueLine: Heels anchored, lower your torso as slowly as you can, push back up with your hands.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
exercises.cueLine: Dumbbells at your sides, step forward, back knee to the floor, step through.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.cueLine: Step back, lower the back knee toward the floor, push through the front foot to stand.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.cueLine: Back foot on a bench, dumbbells at your sides, lower straight down.

exercises.name: Step-Up
exercises.cueLine: Step onto a bench with your whole foot, drive up, lower under control.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.cueLine: Long stance, lower the back knee straight down, keep the front knee over the foot.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.cueLine: Balls of the feet on the edge, rise as high as you can, lower for a stretch.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.cueLine: Pads on the knees, rise onto the toes, pause at the top.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
exercises.cueLine: One foot on a step, fingertips on a wall for balance, rise and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Calf Raise
exercises.cueLine: Dumbbells at your sides, rise onto the toes, pause, lower past level.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
exercises.cueLine: Both feet on the edge of a step, rise as high as you can, lower for a stretch.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.cueLine: On your back, arms up, lower the opposite arm and leg while the lower back stays flat.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.cueLine: Hang from a bar, lift the knees to hip height, lower without swinging.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.cueLine: Kneel facing the cable, rope behind your head, crunch the elbows toward the thighs.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.cueLine: On your back, knees bent, curl the hips off the floor toward your chest.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.cueLine: On your back, hands by the ears, bring the opposite elbow and knee together, slow and controlled.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Russian Twist
exercises.cueLine: Sit back to 45°, hold one dumbbell, rotate the ribs side to side.

exercises.name: Couch Stretch
exercises.cueLine: Back knee against a wall or couch, front foot forward, squeeze the glute and stay tall.

exercises.name: Thoracic Opener
exercises.cueLine: Lie with a foam roller or rolled towel across the upper back, arms overhead, breathe into it.

exercises.name: Doorway Pec Stretch
exercises.cueLine: Forearm on the doorframe at shoulder height, step through until the chest opens.

exercises.name: Child's Pose
exercises.cueLine: Knees wide, sit back onto your heels, walk the hands forward and breathe.

exercises.name: Pigeon Stretch
exercises.cueLine: Front shin across the mat, back leg long, fold forward as far as is comfortable.

exercises.name: Lying Hamstring Stretch
exercises.cueLine: On your back, one leg up with a strap or towel, keep the knee mostly straight.

exercises.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.cueLine: Half-kneel, tuck the pelvis, shift forward until the front of the hip stretches.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
exercises.cueLine: Both knees at 90°, sit tall and lean over the front shin.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.cueLine: On all fours, arch and round the spine slowly with the breath.

exercises.name: Wall Lat Stretch
exercises.cueLine: Hands on a wall at hip height, walk back and sink the chest toward the floor.

exercises.name: Wall Calf Stretch
exercises.cueLine: Hands on the wall, back leg straight, heel down, lean in.

exercises.name: Deep Squat Hold
exercises.cueLine: Sit into the deepest squat you can, elbows push the knees out, breathe.

exercises.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch
exercises.cueLine: Pull one arm across the chest with the other, shoulders down.

exercises.name: Figure-Four Stretch
exercises.cueLine: On your back, ankle over the opposite knee, pull the thigh toward you.

exercises.name: Seated Forward Fold
exercises.cueLine: Legs long, hinge from the hips, reach for the shins or toes.

exercises.name: Walk
exercises.cueLine: Easy pace, arms swinging, breathe through your nose — a walk you could talk through.

exercises.name: Run
exercises.cueLine: Short quick steps, shoulders loose, land under your hips, keep a pace you can hold.

exercises.name: Bike
exercises.cueLine: Seat at hip height, light gear, spin smooth circles and keep the upper body quiet.

exercises.name: Swim
exercises.cueLine: Long strokes, exhale under the water, rest at the wall whenever you need to.

exercises.name: Row
exercises.cueLine: Legs, then back, then arms on the drive; arms, back, legs on the way home.

exercises.name: Elliptical
exercises.cueLine: Stand tall, push through the heels, let the handles move you and keep it steady.

exercises.name: Stairs
exercises.cueLine: Whole foot on each step, hands off the rails when you can, steady breathing.

exercises.name: Hike
exercises.cueLine: Short steps uphill, soft knees downhill, water on hand and a pace you can keep.

exercises.name: Other cardio
exercises.cueLine: Anything that gets you breathing harder for a while — log the minutes and move on.
